sn1.70:1.1: Kismiṃ loko samuppanno || kismiṃ kubbati santhavaṃ || kissā loko upādāya || kismiṃ loko vihaññatīti || ||
sn1.70:2.1: Chasu loko samuppanno || chasu kubbati santhavaṃ || channam eva upādāya || chasu loko vihaññatīti || || Addha-vaggo sattamo || ||
sn1.70:3.0: Tass-uddānam || || Nāmam Cittaṃ ca Taṇhā ca || Saṃyojanaṃ ca Bandhanā || Abbhāhat-Uḍḍito Pihito || Icchā Lokena te dasā ti || || ___________________________________________
